{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' weapons}}
The following is a list of the weapons that appear in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'', divided by class and ordered by attack power.
{{Toclimit|2}}

== [[Greatsword (weapon type)|Greatswords]] ==
Greatswords are two-handed swords used by the [[Human|hume]] [[Soldier (Tactics Advance)|Soldier]] and [[Paladin (Tactics Advance)|Paladin]] job classes. As such, shields cannot be equipped at the same time as a greatsword unless they have the Monkey Grip ability. They have high Attack Power and usually provide protection from some status ailment, but give no bonuses to other stats.

== Maces ==
Maces are one-handed weapons used by the [[Sage (Tactics Advance)|Sage]] and [[Alchemist (Tactics Advance)|Alchemist]] job classes. They can also be equipped by [[Runeseeker]] [[Babus Swain]], but he cannot learn new skills from them. Maces generally give a nice boost to the Magic Resistance stat and are the source of some of the most powerful spells, including [[Meteor (ability)|Meteor]] and [[Giga Flare]].

== Bows ==
Bows are ranged weapons that can be equipped by the [[Human|hume]] and [[viera]] [[Archer (Tactics Advance)|Archer]] job. Each bow has a set range. The number given in the table represents the farthest an Archer will be able to shoot an arrow if the target tile is equal to or less than the height of the tile that the Archer is standing on. Various obstacles, including higher target terrain, may obstruct an arrow and cause it to miss.

== Spears ==
Spears are melee attack weapons that have a two-panel range, and allow the user to pierce through more than one enemy in range by using "Fight". They can be equipped by the [[bangaa]] [[Templar (Tactics Advance)|Templar]] and [[Dragoon (Tactics Advance)|Dragoon]] job classes. They are also required for the Dragoon [[Jump (ability)|Jump]] command, and some give a bonus to the Jump stat.

== Souls ==
Souls are unique one-handed weapons that are used by [[nu mou]] [[Morpher]]s. They can only be obtained after a [[Hunter (Tactics Advance)|Hunter]] captures a monster and sends it to the [[Monster Bank]]. A soul can then be obtained from the monster and the Morpher can learn that monster's skills.

== Guns ==
Guns are long-range weapons that can be equipped by [[moogle]] [[Gunner (Tactics Advance)|Gunners]]. They have low Attack but their learned skills inflict a myriad of status effects. Bullets fired by the "Fight" command can be intercepted by obstacles, terrain, or other units in the line of fire. Gunmanship skills bypass this.
